cards.name: Phlogistic Uprising!

effects.printed_clause: Fusion Summon a FIRE Dragon from GY/Extra using hand/field materials sent to GY and/or GY materials shuffled into Deck, then optionally pay LP in 300 multiples.
effects.lua_implementation: Activation builds hand/field and Necrovalley-filtered GY material groups, checks Fusion material and destination, sends hand/field materials to GY, shuffles GY materials, Special Summons the selected FIRE Dragon as Fusion from GY or Extra, completes procedure, then offers 0 or a payable 300 multiple.

official_references.matched_structure: Fusion Summon using GY materials with alternate material disposition.
Fusion material selection that shuffles GY/banished materials into Deck.

effects.issue: Official references cover GY material use/shuffling, but no official Omega effect Fusion Summons the Fusion Monster itself from the GY with this hybrid disposition. The Lua uses nocheck only for the GY Fusion target; that custom summon legality remains unmatched.

effects.printed_clause: Shuffle "Phlogiston Dragon" from GY; Set this card from GY, banish it when it leaves; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: GY ignition shuffles exact code as cost, Sets this card if legal, and installs leave-field banish redirect under id HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Self-Set/revival-style operation with leave-field banish redirect.

cards.audit_note: Confirmed as an unresolved custom-reference gap, not a demonstrated Lua defect: official scripts cover GY Fusion materials and shuffle disposition, but not a Fusion Summon whose Fusion Monster itself may originate in the GY.

coverage_override.reason: All printed procedures, continuous clauses, activated/triggered effects, branches, and attached once-per-turn restrictions are represented in the listed semantic effect records.
